bagPolicy.summary: Official venue guidance states a maximum bag size of 4.5 x 6.5 inches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; lists a rate starting at $10.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by North Charleston Coliseum. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says food and beverage concessions are available. The venue operates cashlessly.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Official venue guidance describes wheelchair access or accessible seating.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information and lists hours of 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Coliseum's accessible entrance is on the south side off Montague Avenue. The Performing Arts Center's accessible entrance is its front entrance off Montague Avenue.
